name: Spline: Part One
storyline: When his search for his missing wife leads him somewhere impossible, a man becomes trapped in a reality that feels disturbingly aware of him. Something moves in the dark, something that knows more than it should, and escape may require confronting truths that he buried long ago.
summary: A narrative-driven psychological horror game in which a man searching for his missing wife becomes trapped within a distorted reality known as the Spline, navigating hostile environments, persistent threats, and fragmented clues that reveal the nature of the world around him.
